title: Retire the unused legacy theme-axis feature flag

source.ref: No remaining runtime readers after Frequency-only layout owner PR4058

detail: Remove the unused LEGACY_THEME_AXES export and its DesignDef.legacyAxes registry field after actual-source review finds no runtime consumers. Canonical environment normalization and active Frequency skin selection remain covered by the existing design suite; three former flag-value assertions now verify the retired API is absent. A bounded direct probe and negative controls reject flag/property restoration or changed canonical selection. SCAN1130 stays open: its probe is strengthened to require the actual legacy CSS and DAWN font-input retirement as well as absence of the flag. No persisted theme data, janitor actions, skin/font registries, CSS, database or provider operations change.
